name: Theme system and design tokens
purpose: Realises the semantic token layer (colour, spacing, radius, typography, elevation, motion) in both themes and owns theme selection, persistence-data-sqlite, and application.
responsibilities: Load the design tokens from assets/tokens/design-tokens.json as CSS custom properties per assets/tokens/theme.css.
Resolve the initial theme from the persisted user choice, falling back to prefers-color-scheme, falling back to light.
Expose the theme toggle state and persist explicit choices per session and per signed-in user (application-spa-REQ-005).
Guarantee dark and light parity: every semantic token resolves in both themes; a missing dark value is a build-time error, not a runtime fallback.
Serve the motion tokens and the reduced-motion switch consumed by application-spa-REQ-012.
internalStructure: Token definitions are data (JSON), realised once as CSS custom properties on the root element; the active theme is a single attribute swap, never per-component conditionals.

interfaces.name: design tokens
interfaces.description: assets/tokens/design-tokens.json, the canonical token values for both themes.

interfaces.name: theme attribute
interfaces.description: data-theme attribute on the document root; components style exclusively via tokens that respond to it.

tradeoffs: Semantic tokens over raw palette references cost one indirection and buy theme parity, contrast checkability, and re-skinning without component edits.
